name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Aria-hidden atomic placeholder for preserving expected text, icon, or control geometry while structured content is pending.

intent.summary: Aria-hidden atomic placeholder for preserving expected text, icon, or control geometry while structured content is pending.
useWhen: A pending content region has a predictable structure whose geometry should remain stable while data loads.
Text, icon, and control placeholder atoms can be composed to approximate the final hierarchy and arrangement.
The owning region can expose busy state and contextual loading status independently.
avoidWhen: An action or operation is progressing without predictable content structure; use Loader.
The final layout is unknown or likely to differ substantially from the placeholder composition.
A complete card, list, or table preset is expected from one Skeleton; compose atomic shapes in the owner.
The shimmer would be used as decoration after content is available.

alternatives.when: An indeterminate action or operation is in progress.
Real text content is already available.
alternatives.reason: Text should replace its placeholder as soon as content is ready.

alternatives.when: A real system glyph is available.
alternatives.reason: Icon renders actual glyph content rather than loading geometry.

accessibility: Skeleton remains hidden from assistive technology because its shapes do not represent content.
The owning content region exposes busy state and a contextual loading status when an announcement is needed.
Do not announce every placeholder atom or duplicate status text across a composed skeleton layout.
The owner preserves focus and meaningful reading order when replacing placeholders with real content.
states: Text, icon, and control variants are atomic metric canvases aligned to their corresponding design-system recipes. Text bars occupy 75% of their line-height canvas, while icon shapes occupy 75% of their square canvas; both remain centered with a proportional 12.5% inset per applicable edge. Control atoms inherit the selected control density's default radius.
Compose approximate line count, hierarchy, widths, and control placement without simulating actual values.
Shimmer is on by default and may be disabled for a static placeholder. Reduced motion always produces the static final shape.
Rounded is an optional visual treatment for icon and control atoms rather than a semantic state.
Omitted background is for primary and secondary surfaces. Explicit faint documents a faint parent while using the same standard base and shimmer tokens; other contexts use matching surface tokens.
The owner decides whether to delay initial visibility and when to replace the complete composition.

preserveLayout uses projected text or a control as the hidden, inert size source, retaining wrapping and responsive dimensions; set isLoading false to reveal that same mounted content. Use one atom per text or control, not a whole page.

Control appearance mirrors the pending control: filled masks the entire container; outlined retains its border with icon or text atoms; borderless masks only those contents. Set controlContent to match the control anatomy and preserveLayout to retain its exact footprint.
responsiveBehavior: The owning layout changes placeholder count, width, visibility, and arrangement to match its real responsive content.

Set collapseLabel on a control skeleton when its real control opts into compact table-caption behavior. It follows the same table or standalone data-toolbar measurement, replacing icon-and-label anatomy with a centered icon while preserving the enclosing control footprint.
Other skeletons do not infer breakpoints or rearrange sibling atoms. Icon canvases retain their square geometry in flex layouts.

customElements: Compose one element per placeholder atom and set aria-busy or loading status on the containing content region.
react: Render Skeleton and real content from one loading branch so placeholder geometry and region busy state settle together.
angular: Render Skeleton and real content from one loading branch so placeholder geometry and region busy state settle together.

styling.rationale: The component owns the protected recipes below; unspecified host properties and application layout remain customizable.

protected.reason: The selected presentation owns its metric canvas; use the supported size or variant props and keep placement in the parent.
The component owns its surface and interaction treatment; use its semantic presentation props or compose an application-owned surrounding surface.

background.description: Actual parent surface context. Omit on primary and secondary surfaces.

collapseLabel.description: Follow the owning table or data toolbar's compact icon-only control presentation.

controlAppearance.description: Filled controls replace the entire shape; other appearances retain the frame and mask its contents.

controlContent.description: Content anatomy for outlined and borderless control placeholders.

controlSize.description: Shared control-density size whose height defines the control canvas.

iconSize.description: Iconography token whose square canvas defines the icon canvas.

isLoading.description: With preserveLayout, reveal the same projected content when loading completes.

preserveLayout.description: Derive geometry from a projected control or text instead of estimating its footprint.

rounded.description: Round icon skeletons into circles and control skeletons into pills. Ignored for text.

shimmer.description: Whether to show the shimmer animation.

textVariant.description: Text metric recipe whose line-height defines the text canvas.

width.description: Width of text and control skeleton canvases. Numbers resolve to px. Ignored for icons.

slots.description: Real text or a control whose footprint is retained with preserveLayout.
